description:
An Undeniably Dominating Experience.
Color: Shadow Black

Equipped with Bosch e-assist

With a whisper quiet motor capable of 75Nm of torque, this system is wickedly fun. Go from the “all-day ride” Eco mode to an exhilarating Turbo mode with a few clicks of a button on your Smart LED Remote.

The Bosch Smart System ushers in the digital eBike future by fully connecting the eBike Flow app with all eBike components. This allows for over-the-air updates and continuous new functions, like navigation and enhanced theft protection, keeping your eBike current and your riding experience personalized.

Designed for performance, the Spyder is stiffer and aerodynamic where it needs to be for acceleration and sustained speed, and yet compliant for comfort. All elements of the trike converge to deliver a performance machine which will satisfy your inner speed freak.

The Spyder’s frame is comprised of a two-piece aluminum Y-frame design. The front section is a 7000 series aluminum, while the rear triangle is also a 7000 series. These two couple together to deliver a perfect balance of performance and compliance. The frame also sits low to the ground, giving riders optimal aerodynamics.

Heart-racing power is delivered through the Spyder’s premium drivetrain. At the front of the trike sits a Shimano 105 double crankset, bottom bracket, and derailleur. These premium components are all mounted to a brand-new boom design, made specifically for the Spyder.

A Shimano XT derailleur connected to a 10-speed wide range cassette sits on the 700c rear wheel, and is connected via a through axel for increased rigidity. The new, innovative idler pulley improves chain engagement and power transfer, while deep profile TerraTrike rims, Schwalbe Kojak tires, and TerraTrike alloy hubs cleanly propel the trike.

Feel pure comfort and control in the Spyder’s new Sport Touring seat, made of a breathable mesh and an adjustable upper-back support section. The vertical controls and bar-end shifters give more room and increase aerodynamics, while the Shimano Deore hydraulic brakes provide total control over the machine. Finally, the internal cable routing gives a sleek and aggressive look to your ride.

The Battery Network – Bosch Battery Fee
Please note: a $15 recycling fee will be added to the price of every Bosch product with the new Smart System. This program provides support for battery recycling to riders like you! Learn more about the initiative here: batterynetwork.org
